limitations: Each scenario/universe/variant is diagnosed separately. Repeated trades across runs are not pooled as independent observations.
This reuses already inspected historical data for explanation, not a new independent holdout or a parameter search. Costs and fills remain simulated.
Complete closed-trade ledgers are required. Older aggregate-only reports must be reproduced from their frozen datasets; top winners alone cannot reconstruct losses.
Standard-scenario groups retained for all universe sizes; other scenarios retain totals. No pooling across scenarios/universe sizes.
Current account fees, live settings and Paper/Demo equivalence remain unverified; these are the historical manifest assumptions.
Input report hash includes runtime-dependent duration; frozen dataset and manifest hashes identify the reusable market source.
